title: Define the isolated PDF renderer boundary
description: Select a production PDF library and define an isolated renderer that accepts only a validated printable scene, explicit page geometry, resolved bundled resources, and optional compatible translation data.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected PDF library and redistributable bundled font licenses are documented
The renderer input contains validated scene, explicit page geometry, resolved fonts/assets, and optional compatible x/y translation only
PDF-library types do not leak into pure domain modules or printable-scene values
Unvalidated project state, React nodes, DOM nodes, preview pixels, and browser layout measurements cannot satisfy the renderer input
Translation input defaults to no correction and requires an explicitly compatible typed value
Resource counts and byte sizes are bounded before renderer invocation

steps.details: Evaluate a client-side PDF library and bundled font set for explicit page boxes, deterministic metadata control, glyph embedding or outlining, browser support, and redistribution license; record the decision and links.
Create narrow adapter-owned types for validated scene, millimetre page geometry, resolved resource bytes/metrics, optional compatible translation, and result diagnostics.
Contain PDF document creation and library-specific objects in one renderer module that exposes only application-owned result values.
Reject absent, mismatched, oversized, or unsupported font/asset inputs before allocation and preserve named resource identifiers in diagnostics.
Add compile-time or contract checks proving pure scene modules do not import the PDF library and invalid DOM/project/preview values are not accepted by the renderer API.

technicalNotes: Do not reuse the prototype's ad hoc writer or raster shortcuts as production code.
Optional translation remains zero/absent in this PRD because no physically supported profile exists.
